# `<util/tls.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Per-thread control block (TCB): identity, priority and message box.

Every thread has one TCB slot in its space; the kernel fills the header and IPC copies messages through `buf`. GetTls() finds the current thread's slot.

```c
#include <util/tls.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="page_size"></a>`PAGE_SIZE` | `4096` | Page size in bytes. |
| <a id="tcb_hdr_size"></a>`TCB_HDR_SIZE` | `64` | Bytes of TCB header before the message box. |
| <a id="msg_buf_size"></a>`MSG_BUF_SIZE` | `512` | Size of a thread's message box: the most one Call() or Reply() can carry. |
| <a id="tcb_slot_size"></a>`TCB_SLOT_SIZE` | `(TCB_HDR_SIZE + MSG_BUF_SIZE)` | Bytes per TCB slot (576). |
| <a id="slots_per_page"></a>`SLOTS_PER_PAGE` | `(PAGE_SIZE / TCB_SLOT_SIZE)` | TCB slots per page (7). |
| <a id="tcb_max_slots"></a>`TCB_MAX_SLOTS` | `255` | Most threads per space; 0xFF is reserved to mean "no slot". |
| <a id="max_tcb_pages"></a>`MAX_TCB_PAGES` |  | Pages reserved for TCB slots in every space (37). |

## Structures

### `ThreadLocalData` { #threadlocaldata }

One thread's TCB slot. The header is written by the kernel; treat it as read-only.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `msg_buf` | `void *` | Address of `buf`, set by the kernel. |
| `tid` | [`Tid`](../../types.md#tid) | Thread ID. |
| `spid` | [`Spid`](../../types.md#spid) | ID of the owning space. |
| `prio` | `uint8_t` | Base priority. |
| `max_prio` | `uint8_t` | Highest priority the thread may set. |
| `padding` | `uint8_t` | Pads the header to TCB_HDR_SIZE. |
| `buf` | `uint8_t` | Message box used by Call(), Reply() and receives. |
